conclusion: Label-free full-document OCR changes pilot17 from zero-signal retrieval to ranking the single gold page first under both query-token policies.
causal_interpretation: OCR is the decisive intervention for this case. Query-token deduplication is neither necessary nor harmful to the gold-page rank here.
cross_case_interpretation: Pilot16 and pilot17 jointly support full-document OCR as an R2 scanned-document representation route. Pilot16 retains a multi-page lexical-ranking failure after OCR, whereas pilot17 is fully recovered at rank 1.
scope_note: Gold evidence page 12 was used only after ranking for evaluation. No answer-generation API call was made.
